camel_example: aliyun iot InvokeThingsService --region cn-hangzhou --Args 'param1_:1' --Identifier Set --DeviceName.1 'example-string' --ProductKey a1BwAGV0000
description_zh: 调用该接口批量调用设备服务
kebab_example: aliyun iot invoke-things-service --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --identifier Set --args param1_:1 --device-name example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: InvokeThingsService

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If the instance has an ID, you must specify the ID. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Instance Overview page or the ID is not displayed, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the device whose service is to be invoked belongs
parameters.help_zh: 要调用服务的设备所隶属的产品ProductKey
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the message delivery mode. Valid values:

0: At most once.
1: At least once. If a message with QoS=1 does not receive a PUBACK message, the message is pushed to the device again when the device reconnects.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default value 0 is used.

For more information about communication messages, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/30527.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定消息的发送方式。取值：

0：最多发送一次。
1：最少发送一次。如果QoS=1消息未接收到PUBACK消息，会在设备重连时，重新推送给设备。

如果不传入此参数，则使用默认值0。

通信消息的更多使用说明，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/30527.html
parameters.name: qos

parameters.help_en:
The identifier of the service.

You can view the service Identifier of a device by using one of the following methods:

Log on to the IoT Platform console and view the identifier in the Define Feature section of the product to which the device belongs.
Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150321.html operation and view the identifier in the returned Thing Specification Language model information.

If the service is testService under the custom (non-default) module testFb, set the value to testFb:testService
parameters.help_zh:
服务的标识符。

设备的服务Identifier的查看方式：

登录物联网平台控制台，在设备所属产品的功能定义中查看。
调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150321.html，从返回的物模型信息中查看。

如果是自定义（非默认）模块testFb下服务testService，则参数值为testFb:testService
parameters.name: identifier

parameters.help_en:
The input parameters of the service to be invoked. The data format is JSON string, for example, Args={"param1":1}.
If this parameter is empty, you must specify **Args={} **.

<notice>If the data type of a Thing Specification Language feature is float or double, the corresponding parameter value must contain at least one decimal place, even if the value is an integer. For example, 10.0 and 11.1.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要启用服务的入参信息，数据格式为JSON String，例如Args={"param1":1}。
若此参数为空时，需传入**Args={} **。

<notice>物模型功能定义数据类型为float或double时，对应参数值（即使值为整数）至少携带一位小数位。例如10.0、11.1。
</notice>
parameters.name: args

parameters.help_en: The list of names of the devices on which the service is to be invoked. You can specify up to 100 device names
parameters.help_zh: 要调用服务的设备的名称列表。最多支持传入100个设备名称
parameters.name: device_name

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful, but this does not mean that the invoked service was executed successfully. Check the device logs for the execution result.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功，但不代表调用的服务执行成功。执行情况，以设备端日志为准。
false：调用失败
